description: This file defines the CyclicBuffer class within the WPEFramework::Core namespace. The class provides mechanisms for shared, process-wide cyclic buffer management, including locking, reading, writing, and buffer administration. It includes nested classes, methods for buffer operations, and synchronization primitives, indicating its role in inter-process data sharing and buffer control.

classes.name: CyclicBuffer
classes.description: A class facilitating shared cyclic buffer management across process boundaries, with methods for locking, reading, writing, and buffer administration, including nested Cursor class for position management.

classes.name: CyclicBuffer::Cursor
classes.description: A helper class for managing read positions within the cyclic buffer, providing peek and tail calculation functionalities.

methods.name: CyclicBuffer
methods.description: Constructors for initializing the cyclic buffer with file parameters or existing buffer.

methods.name: DataAvailable
methods.description: Virtual method called when data becomes available in the buffer.

methods.name: Lock
methods.description: Locks the buffer for exclusive access, optionally waiting for data presence.

methods.name: Unlock
methods.description: Releases the lock on the buffer.

methods.name: Peek
methods.description: Non-destructive read of data from the buffer.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Destructive read, advancing the buffer tail.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes data into the buffer, advancing the head.

methods.name: Reserve
methods.description: Reserves space in the buffer for upcoming writes.
